teaser.en: The Digo call it the 'chicken killer', a blunt warning about the poison in this fragrant-flowered shrub.
teaser.sw: Wadigo wanauita 'muua kuku', onyo la wazi kuhusu sumu iliyo katika kichaka hiki chenye maua yenye harufu nzuri.
teaser.dg: Adigo anauiha 'muolaga kuku', dzina rinaloonya wazi kukala chitsaka hichi chenye maruwa ga arufu nono china sumu.

summary.en: *Muolaga kuku* is the fever pod, a shrub of woodland and bush with white latex, fragrant white flowers and long paired pods. Its Digo name, 'chicken killer', marks it as poisonous.
summary.sw: *Muolaga kuku* ni kichaka kiitwacho kwa Kiingereza *fever pod*, cha misitu ya wazi na vichaka, chenye utomvu mweupe, maua meupe yenye harufu nzuri na maganda marefu yanayokaa kwa jozi. Jina lake la Kidigo, 'muua kuku', linaonyesha kuwa ni sumu.
summary.dg: *Muolaga kuku* ni *fever pod* kpwa Chingereza, chitsaka cha phatu phenye mihi na weruni, chenye maziya mereru, maruwa mereru ga arufu nono na makakaya mare ganayomera mairi-mairi. Dzinare ra Chidigo, 'muolaga kuku', rinaonyesa kukala una sumu.

about.en: *Muolaga kuku* is a shrub or small tree of the oleander family, with white latex in its stems and leaves. Its white flowers are sweetly scented. The fruits are long, thin pods that grow in pairs, splitting to release seeds tufted with silky hairs.
about.sw: *Muolaga kuku* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wa familia ya oleander, chenye utomvu mweupe kwenye mashina na majani. Maua yake meupe yana harufu tamu. Matunda ni maganda marefu membamba yanayoota kwa jozi, ambayo hupasuka kuachia mbegu zenye vishungi vya nywele laini kama hariri.
about.dg: *Muolaga kuku* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide, na ni wa jamii ya *oleander*. Mihiye na makodzage gana maziya mereru. Maruwage mereru gana arufu nono ya mtswano. Matundage ni makakaya mare na membamba ganayomera mairi-mairi; gachiahuka ganalavya tembe zenye vidzundzu vya nyere laini.

where.en: It grows in woodland and bushland.
where.sw: Hukua katika misitu ya wazi na nyika ya vichaka.
where.dg: Unamera phatu phenye mihi na weruni.

culture.en: The name means 'chicken killer'. The plant is considered poisonous, and the name passes that warning on to anyone who learns it.
culture.sw: Jina lake lina maana ya 'muua kuku'. Mmea huu huchukuliwa kuwa na sumu, na jina hilo humpa onyo hilo yeyote anayelijifunza.
culture.dg: Dzina rina mana ya 'unaoolaga kuku'. Atu anaona kukala mmea uhu una sumu, na dzinare rinamuonya chila mutu anayerimanya.

names.en: The Digo name is *muolaga kuku*. In English it is called the fever pod, and botanists know it as *Holarrhena pubescens*. No Swahili name has been recorded.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *muolaga kuku*. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *fever pod*, na wataalamu wa mimea huujua kama *Holarrhena pubescens*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *muolaga kuku*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *fever pod*, na asayansi anauiha *Holarrhena pubescens*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa.

reason.en: Arrow-poison tree, same family and also poisonous
reason.sw: *Utsungu* (arrow-poison tree), wa familia ile ile na pia wenye sumu
reason.dg: *Utsungu*, wa jamii mwenga na piya una sumu.

reason.sw: Mtandamboo, wa familia ile ile ya oleander

reason.en: Another plant whose name warns of harm
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine ambao jina lake linaonya juu ya madhara
reason.dg: Mmea wanjina ambao dzinare rinaonya atu kukala unaweza kuahendera ubaya.
